note: Carson County TX does not publish a county zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The county seat, City of Panhandle, publishes its zoning map only as JPG images (City_of_Panhandle_Zoning_Map.jpg, legend JPG) with no queryable ArcGIS service. ArcGIS searches for Carson County/Panhandle zoning returned none. Groom, White Deer and Skellytown show no zoning service in searches; commercial parcel products list no zoning layer.
